A '''steel chestplate''' is the [[Steel equipment|steel]] [[Armor#Chestplate|chestplate]], made by smithing an [[Iron Chestplate|iron chestplate]] with [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]]. It gives 7 armor and 1 toughness and has 1000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_chestplate.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade uses no template: the template slot of the [[Smithing Table|smithing table]] is left empty.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===

Worn, it gives 7 armor, 1 armor toughness and 0.2 knockback resistance (shown as 2 in the tooltip).

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Blast Protection]] IV

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Steel equipment]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Iron Ingot|iron ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/iron_ingot_from_blasting_iron_materials.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Armor durability and protection were made consistent across tiers (leather < copper < gold, sturdy leather < iron, shakudo, hepatizon, steel < diamond, electrum < adamant). Steel armor names are shown in white.}}
{{History line|0.6-alpha|Added recipe unlocks for steel equipment.}}
{{History line|1.02|Steel alloy takes less time to blast.}}
{{History line|1.03|Steel alloy is now blasted from [[Carbon-Rich Iron|carbon-rich iron]] instead of directly from iron.}}
{{History line|1.10|Armor raised from 6 to 7 and toughness lowered from 2 to 1, to match the rest of the set.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer takes an ingot in the template slot and keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older items can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
}}
